text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, such as individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of a system work together. Many developers use test-driven development, which means they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them catch problems early and improve the design. Although testing takes extra time, it gives developers real confidence. When tests pass, teams can change code without fear of breaking things. In short, good testing leads to more reliable software and happier users.
